label: Glass lock screen -> phone pull-back
description: A full-frame photo becomes an iOS-26 LOCK SCREEN and then pulls back into a PHONE (the relay beat after the orb floods the frame). Beats: the wallpaper full-frame from `at` (object-fit cover -- identical to a plain full-frame photo, so it joins the scene before); big liquid-GLASS clock digits pop in over the wallpaper with the date rising above them (clock_at); a home bar appears at the bottom and STRETCHES up into a glass music player -- track, artist, prev/play/next, a progress line (bar_at, formed by bar_at+0.4); the cursor clicks play and it becomes pause (click_at); the whole screen PULLS BACK into a phone (pullback_at, 0.5 s): the black bezel grows out of the screen edge, the corners round, the Dynamic Island appears, landing on the phone geometry (centre 0.5/0.5, height 0.52 of the frame, width 0.52x0.485, corner radius 0.11 x width, bezel 0.012) on a pale lavender stage with a flowing blue silk swoosh. The lock screen stays on the screen, re-laid from square to tall. Hand-on classes for the next piece: the phone `.gls-phone`, its screen `.gls-screen`, the island `.gls-island`. All times are scene seconds; defaults are relative to `at`. Full-frame box. Example: {"wallpaper":"/assets/astronaut.jpg","date":"Friday, September 25","time":"9:41","track":"motion study 04","artist":"made in code","at":0,"cursor_from":[0.8,0.74],"cursor_to":[0.82,0.77]}.

stage.label: The ground it pulls back onto: {color (default #ecebf5), silk (default true), silk_color (default #2d5bff)}

phone_island.label: Show the Dynamic Island on the phone (.gls-island; default true)

phone_x.label: Phone centre x, fraction of the frame (default 0.5)

phone_y.label: Phone centre y, fraction of the frame (default 0.5)

phone_height.label: Phone height, fraction of the frame (default 0.52)

bezel.label: Bezel width, fraction of the frame (default 0.012)

at.label: Start (s); every default time below is relative to it (default 0)

clock_at.label: Glass clock digits pop in, the date rises (default at+0.5)

bar_at.label: Home bar appears and stretches into the glass player by bar_at+0.4 (default at+1.0)

player_at.label: When the player starts stretching out of the bar (default bar_at+0.12)

click_at.label: The cursor clicks play -> pause (default at+1.6)

pullback_at.label: The screen pulls back into the phone (default at+2.0)

cursor_from.label: Where the cursor starts, [x, y] fractions of the frame (hand-on)

cursor_to.label: Where the cursor rests after the click, [x, y] fractions of the frame (hand-off)
